# AstryxLink { #anylumino.AstryxLink }

```python
AstryxLink(label, *, href='', **props)
```

Render an Astryx text link.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | Default    |
|---------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| label   | str    | Visible or accessible label for the component.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | _required_ |
| href    | str    | Link destination URL.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | `''`       |
| **props | Any    | JSON-safe Link props. Useful keys: hasUnderline, isDisabled, isExternalLink, newTabLabel, target, rel, download, referrerPolicy, tooltip, isStandalone, type, size, weight, color, display, maxLines, className, and style. anylumino manages visible label and href. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Link>. | `{}`       |
